blurb: Rodin's studio house and rose garden, with The Thinker outside.

facts.t: Rodin gave all his works and his own collection to the state in 1916, on condition that the Hôtel Biron, where he worked, become his museum. It opened in 1919, two years after his death.
The museum has a room of sculptures by Camille Claudel, Rodin's student, model and lover, whose own work was overshadowed by his for a century.
